use Coss\Coss;

use Coss\Types\SegmentFilterConditionsItemKey;
use Coss\Types\SegmentFilterConditionsItemKeyField;

use Coss\Types\SegmentFilterMatch;

$client->email->segments->create(
    new CreateSegmentRequest([
        'name' => 'Pro customers',

                    'field' => SegmentFilterConditionsItemKeyField::Property->value,
                    'key' => 'plan',
                    'op' => SegmentFilterConditionsItemKeyOp::Eq->value,
                    'value' => 'pro',
                ]),
